mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS rates signals a tightening monetary policy cycle that raises discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite FEDFUNDS rising, or Rank IC > 0.05 over a 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE below 4.5% triggers a positive 20-day forward return as lower unemployment strengthens labor market confidence and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not fall below 4.5% in the period, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in quarterly demand (GDPC1) and monthly housing demand (HOUST) above their 5-year averages signal robust economic momentum, driving positive 20-day returns.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and HOUST above 5-year averages
failure_condition: The proxies do not both rise above their averages, or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), sustained rate increases compress discount rates on equity valuations, resulting in negative 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of tightening periods, or Rank IC > 0.03 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in supply (INDPRO) above 5-year averages reduces inflationary pressures, leading to positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not rise above 5-year averages, or 5-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When monthly labor participation (PAYEMS) exceeds 140,000, it signals a strong labor market, triggering positive 20-day returns.
failure_condition: PAYEMS does not exceed 140 in the period, or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising demand (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) both above 5-year averages indicate robust economic activity, driving positive 60-day returns through expanded corporate profits.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO above 5-year averages
failure_condition: The proxies do not both rise above their averages, or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-expansion supply surge regime (INDPRO consistently above 115), sustained supply growth lowers inflation expectations, resulting in positive 5-day returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not consistently exceed 115 in the regime, or 5-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
